hypothesis: Y035 showed diminishing aggregate benefit of retained observed assignments as passive hibernation length increased. A new preregistered 12-episode horizon can falsify that monotonic relationship at gaps of five versus seven skipped episodes.
freeze: Both gap lengths, new seeds, frozen 12-episode outer horizon, all model-cost and classification criteria frozen before first-use. No retry, threshold, regime or positive-outcome cherry-pick.
source: Exact Y030 keyed structured-matching geometry with 16 cells/16 keys, 7 active, max9 inactive stored assignments; same policy logic as frozen Y035 retained versus state erasure; both arms observe same set of episodes and no geometry data during hiatus.
time_budget: Both conditions have horizon episodes0..11 (12 possible time ticks, explicitly increased from Y035's eight); no additional keys/cells/memory/model calls. Matching evaluations only at observed episodes, max7 per arm in five-gap and max5 per arm in seven-gap.
arms: keep max-nine inactive plus previous seven active assignment memory frozen during hiatus
erase cache and previous-active placement assignments only at hiatus boundary, charge erasure operations
accounting: Record per seed matching cardinality, returning-key churn, first-reactivation churn, total post-gap churn, cache legality, read attempts and writes, recursion calls and erase work. Preregister cost penalty weights w3, w10; cost=w*churn+searchcalls+writes+reads+erasure_count.
classification: SHORT_ONLY_RETENTION if aggregate five-gap churn benefit>0 and seven-gap benefit<=0; LONG_HORIZON_DECAY if both benefits positive and five-gap aggregate>seven-gap aggregate; NO_DECAY_OR_NEGATIVE otherwise. INVALID if eight unique keyed geometry signatures/independent Hall/cardinality/capacity fail. Publish all perseed negatives.
claim_limit: Synthetic hibernation-like cached assignment survival only; no biological or learned general intelligence claims, no accepted-ref change.
